record.dic_text:
3068 louo {loo'-o}

字根動詞; TDNT - 4:295,538; 動詞

欽定本 - wash 6; 6

1) 沐浴, 洗滌
   1a) 死人
   1b) 清洗傷口的血
2) (禮儀上的) 清洗, 潔淨自己 (#來 10:22|)
3) 潔淨 (#啟 1:5|)
record.edic_text:
3068 louo {loo'-o}

a root verb; TDNT - 4:295,538; v

AV - wash 6; 6

1) to bathe, wash
   1a) of a dead person
   1b) washing to cleanse blood out of wounds
